knownStaleness.topic: The monarch and the Governor General
knownStaleness.problem: References to the Sovereign are pre-accession throughout: five occurrences of "Her Majesty" and eight of "Elizabeth", and zero of "His Majesty". The document is uniformly old on this point rather than partly updated. An earlier note in this file claimed one "His Majesty"; that was a misread of "King Charles II of England" in a 1670 sentence about the Hudson's Bay Company charter.

knownStaleness.topic: The Oath of Citizenship is genuinely mixed
knownStaleness.problem: The cached Oath on page 2 already carries the June 2021 amendment recognising the Aboriginal and treaty rights of First Nations, Inuit and Metis peoples, while still naming Queen Elizabeth the Second. So one passage is simultaneously current and out of date. That is the real 'reads as current in places' hazard in this document, and it is sharper than a uniformly old text would be.
